reported_3e_sensitivity.use: Explicit label/figure-reading sensitivity including the separately declared native-residue scope; neither author-exact labels nor main approval are inferred. No training run authorized.

reported_3e_residue_sensitivity.use: Explicit native/residual Si scope sensitivity, following the existing separate 2E residue purpose; not main approval.

physical_current_warning: No unknown denominator was imputed/converted. Main features are literature descriptors; do not claim calibrated equal physical stress.
3E_reference_policy: Reference identity is a required categorical descriptor; raw reported potentials are not silently converted.
window_evidence_policy: Own actual waveforms or an explicitly reviewed applicable GCD programme in same sample/configuration/electrolyte; evidence kind and caveats saved per record.
baseline_policy: author initial/plotted reference allowed; exact cycle index remains unknown when unreported
split_policy: Unified paper/reuse groups stay together; leave-one-source-out; equal total source weight; no preprocessing before group split.
expansion_rule: One newly reviewed symmetric source appended to all_review and explicit2E nested profiles only; source weights rebuilt per profile, all old scientific rows unchanged.
material_feature_limits: Sparse extra predictors retain None and evidence; raw-unit freezes are excluded from default material predictors.
Reported XPS percentage basis is retained; unspecified percentage is not silently made atomic percent.
Mass loading is a test/configuration property; the new standard3E loadings do not populate2E device tests.
Raman direction and derived reciprocal are retained; isolated source features need training-fold coverage.
This release performs no training and does not establish improved prediction error.
